items.name: motion-kit
items.origin: Adapted motion mechanics from preserved HyperFrames catalog originals; project glue by Evoquex.

items.name: evoquex-v12-effects
items.origin: Mechanics adapted from pinned HyperFrames catalogue, source archives and Apache2 license preserved. Rectangles are explicit, no async layout reads.
items.limits: CSS2.5D only; flipBox counter-scale selected children; no physics/reflow. Native host render validation required.

items.name: evoquex-v13-motion

api.e85: e85(normalizedProgress) -> easedProgress. Cubic-bezier(.85,0,.15,1), solved by24 bisection iterations; use progress0..1.
api.glyphs: glyphs() -> void. Synchronously replaces text of [data-letters] with span.vchar nodes and keeps original text as aria-label; call once before timeline construction.
api.letters: letters(timeline, containerSelector, atSeconds, {x=12,y=100,rot=65,tilt=3,duration=.46,ease="power4.out",stagger=.018}) -> void. One entrance per generated glyph, alternating lateral offset/X/Z rotation.
api.slices: slices(timeline, containerSelector, atSeconds, {distance=130,duration=.5,ease="back.out(1.08)"}) -> void. Exactly3 DOM children.slice; authored y/rotation arrays and35ms offsets recombine the complementary clipped planes.
api.frame: frame(timeline, svgRectAttributeObject, atSeconds, duration=.6) -> void. Tweens attributes of the host #flow-frame SVG rect using e85; fixed global target is intentional.

catalogue_origins.name: text-match-cut
catalogue_origins.mechanic: E85 single smooth motion curve, here24 bisection iterations rather than upstream28.

catalogue_origins.name: pan-stations
catalogue_origins.mechanic: Continuous host world/strip with staged camera stops. Host motion.js owns camera changes; helper does not implement a full station generator.

catalogue_origins.name: type-match-cut
catalogue_origins.mechanic: Type and complementary aperture linked to media-boundary transformation; explicit host clipping/layout needed.

catalogue_origins.name: slit-scan-reveal
catalogue_origins.mechanic: Fragmented temporal arrival followed by coherent resolve adapted as3 clipped DOM planes. This is not the literal96-band Canvas time-sampling renderer.

items.upstream_license: Apache-2.0; full text in biblioteca/hyperframes/LICENSE. GSAP retains its separate vendor license. Local project adaptation does not assert licensing of pack media.
limits: glyphs mutates DOM; not repeat-safe after composition construction unless host recreates original text.
letters selector must address one container; do not pass an ungrouped comma list. The caller owns line breaks, clipping and timeline/initial-state interactions.
slices supports exactly3 children; more children would exceed the authored arrays. It does not subdivide text/images or set masks automatically.
frame is coupled to one SVG rect ID and changes SVG geometry, not CSS layout boxes.
No own timeline registration, audio/media playback, clocks, async font measurements or physics simulation. Host owns deterministic registration and visual acceptance.
items.validation_status: Source copied bit-identically from stable V13 host; final render motion review is separate, not inferred from syntax or catalogue registration.

items.name: evoquex-v14-motion
dependencies: DOM/SVG; CSS 2.5D for glyph entrances; no new dependency

api.glyphs: glyphs() -> void. Synchronously replaces each [data-letters] text with span.vchar nodes, aria-hidden=true, and retains the original text as parent aria-label. Call once before timeline construction.
api.letters: letters(timeline, containerSelector, atSeconds, {y=90,x=0,rx=55,rz=0,opacity=0,duration=.4,stagger=.018,ease="power4.out"}) -> void. Explicit fromTo entrance for generated glyphs; immediateRender=false. The host owns parent visibility and initial state.
api.draw: draw(timeline, svgGeometrySelector, atSeconds, duration=.55) -> void. Reads SVG getTotalLength synchronously, prepares dasharray/dashoffset and draws all matched elements together with power2.inOut.
api.poseFor: poseFor([x0,y0,x1,y1], margin=1) -> {scale,x,y}. Fits an explicit authored world rectangle into the fixed 1080x1920 viewport; same pure framing equation as caption-camera-follow, with no async font or DOM measurement.
api.camera: camera(timeline, nodeOrSelector, authoredBox, atSeconds, duration=.6, margin=1) -> void. Tweens x/y/scale to poseFor with power3.inOut; host must set transformOrigin 0 0 and own world geometry.
api.mesh: mesh(svgGroupSelector) -> {state,render,morph}. Appends 36 SVG polygons with an 18-point outer contour, 9-point inner contour and center. state={phase:0,light:0}; render() derives points and per-face blue lighting from state. morph(timeline, phase, atSeconds, duration=.5) tweens phase with power3.inOut and updates polygons. Five authored states phase0..4: play triangle, arrow, location marker, circle, speech bubble; four continuous transformations.

catalogue_origins.name: facet-morph
catalogue_origins.mechanic: Retains the 18 outer / 9 inner / center topology and 36 corresponding SVG triangles with numeric interpolation and per-face lighting. V14 authors equal-count resampled semantic contours and timeline phase control; it does not copy the original blob/mark/badge forms or entire registry clock.

catalogue_origins.name: caption-camera-follow
catalogue_origins.mechanic: Pure poseFor fit-to-box equation. V14 uses fixed authored portrait boxes, original Portuguese words and power3.inOut; it does not import English text, global GSAP defaults, original blur smear or original timeline.

items.upstream_license: Apache-2.0; complete upstream text preserved in biblioteca/hyperframes/LICENSE and host resources/HyperFrames-LICENSE. Stable host header records the revision and adapted mechanisms. GSAP retains its separate vendor license. Pack media licensing is not implied.
example_usage: mesh morphs through phase1 at9.0s, phase2 at11.35s, phase3 at13.55s and phase4 at17.85s in the V14 host; composition owns placement, scale, masks, motion-path and light animation.

camera moves the proof-world framing at15.9s and visits authored CTA stations at21.67s,22.8s and24.05s. Shared world coordinates keep type positions deterministic; boxes were customized for portrait legibility.
limits: glyphs mutates DOM; call once on original text. Styling .vchar, wrapping, clipping, text layout and font loading belong to the host.
letters appends " .vchar" to one container selector; ungrouped comma lists are not a supported grouping API.
poseFor/camera are fixed to1080x1920, need positive nonzero rectangle dimensions and margin, and expect transformOrigin0 0. They do not auto-detect subject boxes or solve perspective.
draw requires SVG elements supporting getTotalLength; it sets initial stroke style during construction and does not establish stroke paint or clear previous dash settings.

mesh appends36polygons on each call, with no cleanup or reusable factory options. Call once per empty SVG group. The five form tables, blue base RGB[84,166,255], radius185 and lighting are authored constants; changing silhouette requires corresponding resampled contours.

mesh is a deterministic flat SVG facet effect, not a physical3D mesh or general topology/physics engine. state.phase0..4 and state.light are authored timeline values; changing state directly requires calling render().
No own timeline registration, audio/media playback, clocks, async measurements or extra dependencies. The host owns complete scene timing and rendered audiovisual acceptance.
